candidates.label: Aggressive bruiser: hug the inner edge, close hard
candidates.rationale: Targets the HIGH-ENGAGE / LOWER-DURABILITY niche (e>=2) the archive lacks — both current elites sit at engage 0-1. Trades standoff safety for a tight hug band so a frontliner maximizes output + positioning (the two heavily-rewarded judge terms), accepting more incoming. Pure fn of f.hp/maxhp + cd readiness.
candidates.bandBody: const hp=f.hp/(f.maxhp||1); const ready=((f.cd&&f.cd.q)||0)<=0||((f.cd&&f.cd.e)||0)<=0; const base=ready?46:72; const min=Math.max(30,base-10); const max=min+ (hp<0.4?60:40); return {min,max,rush:min,role:'bruiser',hp};

candidates.label: Mid-tempo pulse: commit on CD, drift out between
candidates.rationale: Targets the MID-TEMPO niche (t=1-2) — both elites are high-tempo (0.76-0.84). Hit-and-run: a tight band when a skill is ready (commit), a wider standoff while recharging (drift), producing a slower pulsing cadence rather than constant pressure. Output comes in bursts, safety recovered between.
candidates.bandBody: const hp=f.hp/(f.maxhp||1); const q=((f.cd&&f.cd.q)||0), e=((f.cd&&f.cd.e)||0); const ready=q<=0||e<=0; const min=ready?44:150; const max=ready?96:230; return {min,max,rush:ready?min:160,role:ready?'bruiser':'ranged',hp};

candidates.label: Desperation dive: the lower the HP, the harder it commits
candidates.rationale: Targets the LOW-DURABILITY niche (d=0-1) — both elites are near-full-HP survivors (0.97-0.98). Inverts the usual HP-gated retreat: a hurt cat dives INWARD to end the fight fast (speed+output rewarded) instead of kiting, a MOBA 'all-in when behind' policy. Recombines baseline's healthy band with an inverted hurt branch.
candidates.bandBody: const hp=f.hp/(f.maxhp||1); if(hp<0.35){const min=32,max=78;return {min,max,rush:min,role:'assassin',hp};} const min=Math.round(60+hp*40); const max=min+70; return {min,max,rush:min,role:'bruiser',hp};

candidates.label: Mutation of stand-at-max elite: pull the standoff 25% inward
candidates.rationale: Island-evolution mutation of the current #2 elite (stand-at-max-range 0.75): keeps its ranged-standoff shape but pulls min/max ~25% inward so it still kites but actually contributes output + stays in positioning range — testing whether a less-passive version of the runner-up beats baseline while landing in a nearby-but-distinct engage cell.
candidates.bandBody: const hp=f.hp/(f.maxhp||1); const min=150, max=235; return {min,max,rush:170,role:'ranged',hp};
